item.title: Groups remove almost 1,400 pounds of trash from downtown Huntsville
item.description: Nearly 1,400 pounds of trash were removed from Huntsville's Spring Branch on Saturday thanks to the Tennessee Riverkeeper, Model Environment, and The Orion Amphitheater.

item.title: Police arrest murder suspect in shooting at Huntsville apartment
item.description: Authorities say police are present off Jordan Road looking for a murder suspect in a shooting earlier this week at a Huntsville apartment complex, and several schools in the area are on secure perimeter.

item.title: Scott Stadthagen elected new chairman of Alabama GOP
item.description: Stadthagen replaces former Chairman John Wahl, who entered Alabama's race for Lt. Governor after receiving an endorsement from President Trump.

item.title: ALEA renews calls for leads in death of Rogersville woman
item.description: The Alabama Law Enforcement Agency renewed calls for leads in an unsolved Rogersville homicide on Sunday.

item.title: Iran clerics choose Khamenei's son as next supreme leader

item.title: Tuscumbia woman arrested following armed robbery in Killen
item.description: A Tuscumbia woman was arrested following an armed robbery in Killen, authorities said Sunday.

item.title: One dead following Huntsville Police chase
item.description: The Huntsville Police Department says a person was killed after a police chase on Brookline Drive Sunday afternoon.
